positioning.value: Otter是AI记事本/会议助手，通过转录、自动摘要、AI聊天等功能构建知识库并驱动工作流。

target_user.value: 目标用户包括个人、小团队、学生、组织及企业；Pro面向专业人士或小团队，Business面向大团队，Enterprise面向组织。

core_capability.value: 核心能力包括：AI记事员可加入会议或录制，捕捉完整对话、跟踪要点、处理后续；AI聊天可搜索会议和连接应用即时回答问题并生成内容；支持多语言实时转录和说话人识别；将会议转化为包含决策、行动项和洞察的清晰摘要；自动化行动项；将销售洞察推送到CRM。

free_tier.value: 免费Basic档提供每月300分钟转录额度、每会话30分钟、每用户终身可导入3个音视频文件。

start_price.value: 官网显示最低付费档为Business From $19.99/month per user（7天免费试用），Basic为Free forever。

price_model.value: 订阅制，分为Basic（免费）、Pro、Business、Enterprise四档；Pro和Business按用户每月或每年计费，Enterprise定制报价。

key_limit.value: Pro：每月1,200分钟转录、每会话90分钟、每月10个音视频导入、最多2个并发会议；Business：每月6,000分钟转录、每会话4小时、无限音视频导入、最多3个并发会议。

deployment.value: 提供云服务、浏览器扩展和API，可通过Web浏览器和移动应用访问；第三方目录还列出Windows、macOS桌面应用和Chrome扩展。

data_policy.value: 官方帮助中心显示用户可选择是否允许Otter及其第三方服务商访问对话用于训练和产品改进（包括人工审查）；若选择不允许，Otter不会访问对话用于训练和改进。

positioning.value: Granola 是一个 AI 记事本，转录会议并用转写上下文增强用户的粗略笔记。

target_user.value: 面向连续开会人群（back-to-back meetings），受顶尖创始人、投资人和招聘者信赖；iPhone 版适合咖啡约见、电话和会议日。

core_capability.value: 设备端采集音频、无机器人入会、实时转写并立即删除音频且不存储录音；AI 增强笔记，用户笔记保持黑色、AI 增补为灰色，用户可完全控制保留内容。

free_tier.value: Basic 免费版：应用内仅可查看过去 30 天的笔记历史，每日转写次数无限制，集成仅限 Slack。

start_price.value: 最低付费档 Business 为 14 美元/用户/月。

price_model.value: 按席位（active user）计费，不按会议次数或存储容量；每个活跃用户支付固定月费，账单随团队成员加入或离开自动调整。

key_limit.value: Basic 免费版仅保留最近 30 天笔记历史，Business/Enterprise 无限制；每日转写次数无限制。

rejected.value: 提供 Desktop 和 iPhone 应用；支持 Google Workspace 或 Microsoft 登录并集成日历；Desktop 版支持 Zoom、Meet、Teams 等任何会议平台，iPhone 版面向面对面会议。
Granola 不允许第三方（如 OpenAI、Anthropic）使用用户数据训练模型；Granola 会使用匿名化数据改进产品，用户可在设置中退出，企业用户默认关闭模型训练。

positioning.value: Fathom records, transcribes, and summarizes your Zoom, Google Meet, or Microsoft Teams meetings so you can focus on the conversation instead of taking notes!

target_user.value: Fathom is an AI meeting assistant designed for small and mid-sized businesses across sales, customer success, HR, product, and operations teams.

core_capability.value: Meeting notes, insights and action items sync automatically with your tools – Slack, Salesforce, HubSpot, Notion, Asana, and beyond.

free_tier.value: 免费版每月前 5 次通话可使用高级摘要，之后仅提供通用/增强模板。

price_model.value: 按用户每月计费，所有计划均按席位定价；提供免费计划，录制与转录无每次会议限制。

key_limit.value: Team 和 Business 计划均要求至少 2 个席位。

deployment.value: 提供 Chrome 扩展录制，桌面应用录制为 Mac 测试版；会议机器人通过日历同步自动加入会议，暂未提供移动应用。

data_policy.value: AI 子处理器不会用用户数据训练模型；Fathom 可能使用去标识化客户数据改进自有模型，用户可随时在设置中选择退出。

positioning.value: Fireflies is your AI notetaker assistant that helps you capture, transcribe, summarize, and search meetings – all in one secure workspace.

target_user.value: Teams in sales, recruiting, and operations, among other departments, via agentic AI apps customized for specific team functions.

core_capability.value: Transcribes, summarizes, searches, and analyzes meeting conversations automatically; features include 99% transcription accuracy, 100+ languages, speaker recognition, auto-language detection, AI summaries, 200+ AI Skills, conversation intelligence, and CRM/PM/ATS/MCP integrations.

free_tier.value: The Free plan includes 3 free meeting transcriptions by default (Auto Join unlocks unlimited transcriptions), AI-powered notes, collaboration tools, 400 minutes of storage per seat, 20 one-time AI credits per seat, up to 2 hours of recording per meeting, uploads of MP3/MP4/WAV/M4A files up to 100MB and 150 minutes per file, and 3 public channels.

start_price.value: Pro is the lowest paid plan at $10/mo/user billed annually, or $18/mo/user billed monthly.

price_model.value: Paid plans are subscription-based per user per month: Pro $10/mo/user annually or $18/mo/user monthly, Business $19/mo/user annually or $29/mo/user monthly, Enterprise $39/mo/user annually. Upload transcription overage is billed at $0.01/minute beyond 3,000 minutes/user/month/source.

key_limit.value: Free plan uploads: video max 100 MB, audio max 500 MB; paid plans video max 2 GB, audio max 500 MB; file duration max 150 minutes. Paid upload processing is 3,000 minutes/user/month/source, with $0.01/minute overage; team cap is 3,000 minutes/seat/month/source, with $0.01/minute overage after 150,000 minutes.

deployment.value: Available as Desktop App, bot for joining online meetings, Mobile App, Chrome Extension, dialers & API, and audio/video file upload.

data_policy.value: Fireflies does not use your meeting content or personal data to train AI models; vendors are contractually prohibited from training AI models on your data. Meeting audio, video, transcripts, and summaries are not retained by third-party vendors after processing.

positioning.value: AI-powered meeting intelligence platform for sales and customer success teams.

target_user.value: More than 3 million users rely on tl;dv every day: sales teams, customer success organizations, consulting firms, and any team where meeting knowledge is a critical asset.

core_capability.value: One capture layer. Any platform. Your way. Bot or bot-free. Zoom, Google Meet, Teams, in-person. Over 100 languages transcribed at >95% accuracy. Your CRM updates itself. Your follow-ups draft themselves. Custom templates run your playbook on every single call: MEDDIC, SPIN, SPICE, or whatever your team has built. 5,000+ integrations for the rest.

free_tier.value: Free plan includes unlimited recordings and transcriptions, 10 AI meeting notes and 10 AI queries per month, no card details needed, no expiry, and no 4-month deletion clock.

start_price.value: Pro plan starts at $18/month billed annually, or $29/month billed monthly.

price_model.value: tl;dv is priced per seat (per user), with monthly or annual billing options.

key_limit.value: Free plan includes 10 AI meeting notes and 10 AI queries per month; other feature limitations exist but are not specified.

deployment.value: Cloud-based SaaS: recordings, transcripts, and meeting data are processed and stored in the EU, on AWS Frankfurt and Google Cloud infrastructure.

data_policy.value: No model training on user calls; recordings, transcripts, and meeting data are processed and stored in the EU and never used to train AI models.
